PROFIL
• Basic technical training with further training in the commercial sector
• Professional experience in procurement
• You have an enthusiasm for numbers
• Very good German and English skills at level B2 in word and writing, further languages beneficial
• Negotiation skills
• In-depth experience in dealing with ERP systems and office applications TASK
• Team management and management of material calculations
• Creating material calculations
• Price inquiries, - comparisons, appointment monitoring
• Obtaining and analysing offers
• Preliminary and post-calculations
• Close cooperation with sales, engineering, order processing and production
